entities.name: Rüdiger Frank
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rüdiger Frank is a German economist and expert on North Korea and East Asia. He currently lives and works in Vienna, Austria, as a tenured full professor of East Asian economy and society at the University of Vienna. Frank also serves as the head of the Department of East Asian Studies at the University of Vienna and is an adjunct professor at Korea University and at the University of North Korean Studies in Seoul.
